author: 刘明
title: Shandong University connects three cities through shared memories
text:
Shandong University's unique three-city layout has left an indelible mark on its graduates. From the academic pursuit in Jinan and the stargazing solitude in Weihai to the fresh beginnings by the sea in Qingdao, these diverse urban landscapes have helped shape the students during their formative years.
These snapshots reflect more than just campus memories. They capture a profound transition from rigorous academic pursuit to the bold exploration of future possibilities.
As graduates embark on new paths, they carry the spirit of resilience and curiosity fostered across these cities. Together, these experiences form a lasting legacy of inspiration and discovery.
